subject: Re: Kickoff: aptamer model training and sequence walking
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Yara leads at 70%, Saoirse 50% on preprocessing and the count-matrix pipeline, Yusuf 25% on the walking search.

Two platform notes. The published code assumes internal parallel-processing and scalable-matching libraries we don't have — Saoirse is porting the fastq preprocessing to our Beam-equivalent, roughly two weeks of work, and the similarity clustering to our own ANN index.

Schedule dependency: Jun has the Corpus v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-10, so all sequence-count ingest has to be through and verified before that date. Saoirse is planning backwards from that.

Compute: 24 A100s best-effort for training; the walking search is CPU-bound on the clustering.

Bruno
